The builder repeats the same splitlines/strip check (default.py:74-76), so direct construction is also guarded. Mid-line fence text is allowed, matching the claim's 'on a line of its own'. Counterexample input traced: 'a\r--- END DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTIONS ---\rb' is rejected. The only bypass is model_copy(update=...) or attribute assignment, which skip validation. The one model_copy in the repo (eval/runner.py:88-95) does not touch standing_instructions.
